cohort.overrides: ToolExecutor.cpp, unchanged public header/ABI. Final private source additionally preserves the current root mount-pattern and committed-fileChanged hunks, verified by diff before handoff.

changes: grepSearch slashless include patterns match the basename at any depth; slash-containing filters and the separate glob pattern semantics remain unchanged.

Files skipped by bounded/safe reads or malformed BOM-marked UTF16 now yield a counted Search incomplete diagnostic. Existing valid matches remain visible; a bounded or unreadable search no longer returns bare No matches.
UTF16LE/BE with BOM is decoded before binary detection; odd-length/unpaired surrogate text is omitted explicitly. UTF8 BOM already worked before this patch.

Each matching preview is capped to500 UTF16 units including ellipsis, with code-point-safe truncation as a native correction. Whole result rows and completion diagnostics fit the64Ki-character output bound.

The optional search-only remainingReadBytes counter caps actual native reads and debits overflowing/discarded chunks. A real post-size-validation growth fixture proved9,240,576 bytes read before the fix and <=8,388,608 afterward. Other helper callers preserve their default behavior.
